about_the_game:
There are no monsters here.

Only people.

You can't believe it's still there. The remains of Mannyland. That 90's theme park based on the popular character franchise 'Manny and Friends'. Somehow, knowing this fills you with a sinking feeling. The call of unresolved memories pull you back... And now you have the key.

EXPLORE and DISCOVER this retro-inspired psychological horror game in three ACTS.

ACT I will be available as a free download on the 31st of October, 2025.

Point and click horror game about nostalgia. You begin in a theme park forgotten to the world for over a decade. What you uncover will take you further down, below the surface, to man-made horrors you can comprehend.

FEATURES:

  • Over 200 hand-drawn 2D backgrounds,

  • 3D Environments with a hand-drawn style,

  • Things to click on,

  • 0% monster chase scenes!!,

  • Reluctant jump scares,

  • Pain and Suffering :(

  • AAA Game (There's three A's in the title),

  • Highly specific humour based on 1990's British life, 

  • Features the Toxic Best Friend Simulator,

  • Made by one person!

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains themes of a mature nature that may be triggering.
TRIGGER WARNINGS:
Graphic descriptions of physical injuries to adults and children.
Psychological horror, emotional abuse and trauma, mental illness, self harm and suicide. 
Crude language.
References to alcohol and alcohol abuse.
Contains flashing imagery.
